description: Source code for managing pack geometry in a Git repository, including functions for initializing, splitting, selecting preferred packs, removing redundant packs, and releasing resources.

methods.name: pack_geometry_weight
methods.description: Calculates the weight of a pack based on the number of objects, after opening its index.

methods.name: pack_geometry_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting packs by weight.

methods.name: pack_geometry_init
methods.description: Initializes the pack geometry structure by collecting relevant pack files based on criteria.

methods.name: pack_geometry_split
methods.description: Splits the pack list into groups based on geometric progression of sizes.

methods.name: pack_geometry_preferred_pack
methods.description: Returns the largest pack above the split line that is suitable for repacking.

methods.name: pack_geometry_remove_redundant
methods.description: Removes redundant packs based on a list of names and existing packs.

methods.name: pack_geometry_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with pack geometry.
